methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2023, 73% of our $67.6 billion in net sales were from the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor (including 64% from the Department of Defense (DoD))' (FY2023 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on contracts with the U.S. Government for a substantial portion of our business. ... Our contracts with the U.S. Government are conditioned upon the continuing availability of Congressional appropriations.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing, ECOMMERCE (live from 2015-01-01) to e-commerce displacing physical retail, malls, grocery and distribution, STREAMING (live from 2015-08-04) to streaming displacing linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles, ENERGY_TRANSITION (live from 2015-12-12) to decarbonisation stranding oil, gas and coal reserves and refining, EV (live from 2020-01-01) to battery-electric vehicles displacing ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail, CRYPTO (live from 2020-10-21) to crypto-assets disintermediating payments networks, banks, exchanges and remittance, GENAI (live from 2022-11-30) to generative or autonomous AI substituting software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content and mobility, and GLP1 (live from 2023-08-08) to GLP-1 obesity drugs reducing demand for snacks, beverages and sleep-apnea, diabetes and cardio devices; the 10-K names no offshore competition, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, crypto-assets or GLP-1 drugs and does not mention cloud; Lockheed Martin holds no oil, gas or coal reserves or refining, and the 10-K names climate change only as a source of regulation and cost ('potential impacts relating to climate change could result in laws, regulations or policies that significantly increase our direct and indirect operational and compliance burdens') and of severe weather ('extreme weather conditions, some of which may be exacerbated by climate change'); the 10-K names artificial intelligence only among technological advances enabling new factors of competition ('Technological advances in such areas as additive manufacturing, data analytics, digital engineering, artificial intelligence, advanced materials, autonomy and robotics, and new business models such as commercial access to space') and as a threat in others' hands ('the use of emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing, for nefarious purposes'), never as a substitute for its aircraft, missiles, helicopters and satellites, so no disruption theme in scope is live

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.1%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.2%/yr (FY24 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct
